# f5os_auth (Resource)

Manage AAA authentication on F5OS. Includes authentication method order and role GID mappings.

The `f5os_auth` resource allows you to configure authentication settings on F5OS devices, including:
- Authentication method order (local, RADIUS, TACACS+, LDAP)
- Remote role GID mappings for external authentication systems

~> **Note:** This resource manages authentication configuration that affects system access. Changes should be tested carefully to avoid being locked out of the system.

## Example Usage

### Basic Authentication Order

```terraform
resource "f5os_auth" "example" {
  auth_order = ["local", "radius", "tacacs"]
}
```

### Complete Authentication Configuration

```terraform
resource "f5os_auth" "complete" {
  auth_order = ["local", "ldap", "radius"]

  remote_roles = [
    {
      rolename   = "admin"
      remote_gid = 9000
    },
    {
      rolename   = "operator"
      remote_gid = 9001
    },
    {
      rolename   = "ldap-users"
      remote_gid = 5000
      ldap_group = "cn=f5-admins,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"
    }
  ]
}
```

### LDAP-Only Authentication

```terraform
resource "f5os_auth" "ldap_only" {
  auth_order = ["ldap"]

  remote_roles = [
    {
      rolename   = "admin"
      remote_gid = 1000
      ldap_group = "cn=f5-administrators,ou=groups,dc=company,dc=com"
    },
    {
      rolename   = "operator"
      remote_gid = 1001
      ldap_group = "cn=f5-operators,ou=groups,dc=company,dc=com"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_order` (List of String) Ordered list of authentication methods. The system will attempt authentication in the specified order. Allowed values: `local`, `radius`, `tacacs`, `ldap`. If not specified, the existing authentication order on the device is preserved.

- `remote_roles` (Set of Object) Remote role mappings for external authentication systems. Each role can be mapped to a specific GID and optionally associated with an LDAP group. See [nested schema](#nested-schema-for-remote_roles) below.

- `password_policy` (Object) Password policy settings. **Note: This feature is currently defined in the schema but not yet implemented. Configuration will be ignored with a warning.**

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier for the authentication resource. Always set to `"f5os-auth"`.

<a id="nested-schema-for-remote_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remote_roles`

Remote roles define mappings between external authentication systems and F5OS roles.

Required:

- `rolename` (String) The name of the F5OS role. Common roles include `admin`, `operator`, `guest`.

Optional:

- `remote_gid` (Number) The remote group ID that maps to this role. Must be greater than or equal to 1. This GID is used by external authentication systems (RADIUS, TACACS+, LDAP) to determine user roles.

- `ldap_group` (String) LDAP group distinguished name (DN) that maps to this role. Used specifically for LDAP authentication to map LDAP group membership to F5OS roles.

## Import

The authentication resource can be imported using the synthetic ID:

```shell
terraform import f5os_auth.example f5os-auth
```

## Notes

- **Authentication Order**: The order specified in `auth_order` determines the sequence in which authentication methods are attempted. If a method is not reachable or fails, the next method in the list is tried.

- **Role Mappings**: Remote roles are used by external authentication systems to map external group memberships to F5OS roles. The `remote_gid` is typically used by RADIUS and TACACS+ systems, while `ldap_group` is used for LDAP-based authentication.

- **Password Policy**: While the `password_policy` attribute is defined in the schema, it is not currently implemented. Any configuration provided for this attribute will be ignored and a warning will be logged.

- **Safety**: Always ensure that at least one authentication method (typically `local`) is configured and that you have valid credentials for that method before making changes that could affect system access.
